gallery.title: File:6408-DenSkyline-BrownPalaceCosmoHotels.Jpg
gallery.description: Downtown Denver skyline looking southeast, 1964. Includes Denver's oldest church (Trinity United Methodist - 1820 Broadway), the first building of the Mile High Center complex, the Lincoln Center, the old brownstone part of the Brown Palace Hotel, and the Cosmopolitan Hotel, since demolished. Taken with a 35mm Exakta VX SLR camera and Ektachrome color slide film.
